Concept 1 · Final design, round 2 · 17 Nov 2026

Arrival sheet

The country question and the cookie question as one V2 sheet on phones, with the cookie settings as the same sheet expanded into a drawer. Phones only for now: from 980 px wide, desktop keeps the LM-14080 cookie bar and today's country pop-up. Drawn at real size over the live homepages, with the shop's own tokens. The wording is unchanged.

  • Builds on LM-14080 (new ticket on top)
  • Scope phones, below 980 px
  • Release everyone, no A/B test

Phone · visitor in France lands on lumas.de

Two steps, one sheet

Country first, cookies second. Two short dashes show where the visitor is: the first filled on the country question, both on the cookie question. They carry over to the French site, so the switch reads as one journey.

Prototype

Try both paths, and the settings drawer

Hier bleiben
The sheet keeps its place, eases its height to the cookie step in 220 ms and the second dash fills. Focus moves to the new title if it was inside the sheet.
Ja, ich möchte wechseln.
The sheet slides away and the browser goes to fr.lumas.com with ?from=de. There the sheet slides up on step 2 and the second dash fills. The script then drops from from the address.
Einstellungen ändern
The same sheet grows upward into the settings drawer. The categories scroll inside, the two buttons stay pinned at the bottom. The cross takes it back to the cookie step.
OK und weiter / Auswahl speichern
Saves through the existing saveConsent() and slides the layer away in 220 ms.

Phone · settings, and visitors with one question

The settings are the sheet, opened further

No modal, no darkened page. The footer link “Cookie-Einstellungen” opens the same drawer later on; there the cross simply closes it. Visitors with only one question see no dashes.

Handoff

Spec, in shop tokens

Every value is an existing token or mixin in frontend/themes/white/assets/sass. Nothing new is introduced. Sizes in rem, 1rem = 10 px.

#PartValues
1Sheet, phone--color-surface-page, top hairline 0.1rem --color-border-default, no shadow. Padding --sp-4 --sp-5 --sp-2 (the text action's tap height is the bottom space). Three groups with gap --sp-3: dashes, text, actions; inside the text group gap --sp-2; actions add --sp-1 on top. Fixed at inset-block-end: var(--bottom-nav-height, 0). z-index cookie-notification.
2Step dashesTwo dashes 2rem × 0.2rem, gap --sp-1. Done or current --color-text-primary, next --color-border-default; colour transition --motion-default. Only when both steps are in play; on arrival the second fills as the sheet slides in. Own row at the top of the sheet.
3Eyebrow--font-body (regular) 1.2rem / 1.4, caps, 0.08em, --color-text-secondary: quieter than the title and the bold button labels, text-wrap: balance (no single word on the last line). Arrival variant in --color-text-primary and bold, with flag and check icon.
4Title--font-display 2.4rem / 1.2; 2.2rem in the drawer head. Sentence case, --color-text-primary.
5Body--font-body 1.4rem / 1.45, --color-text-secondary. Link --color-text-link, underlined.
6Primary buttonbtn-base with min-inline-size: 30rem, so every step's primary button has the width of the country button (“Ja, ich möchte wechseln.”) and the sheet keeps its shape between steps; a longer label (e.g. English) grows past it. min-block-size: 4.4rem, padding-block: 0, padding-inline: --sp-6 so it is one tap target tall and no taller. Flag 1.8 × 1.2rem, gap --sp-2.
7Text action--font-body-bold 1.2rem, caps, 0.14em (matches the button), underline offset 0.5rem, min-block-size: 4rem. “Einstellungen ändern” adds shorthands.icon(arrow-right). Wraps under the button when the row is full.
DesktopOut of scope for now. From tablet-landscape (980 px) the sheet stays dormant and the LM-14080 cookie bar and today's country pop-up run as they do now.
Settings drawerThe same layer, expanded; height eases with --motion-fast. Up to calc(100dvh - var(--bottom-nav-height) - 4.8rem), list scrolls, buttons pinned and stacked (btn-secondary then primary, full width). Checkboxes 2rem, border --color-border-focus, checked --color-surface-inverse, “Notwendig” on --color-surface-muted. Cross: back to the cookie step, or closes when the answer already exists. Esc does the same. No backdrop.
MotionEnter: slide up, --motion-default (320 ms) --motion-easing. Step change and drawer: height + content fade, --motion-fast (220 ms). Leave: slide down, --motion-fast. None with prefers-reduced-motion.
Focusshorthands.focus-outline on every control. On step change or drawer open, focus moves to the new title (tabindex="-1") only if it was inside the layer.

Brandbook s03 and s04, checked 17 Nov 2026

Brand notes

  • Eyebrow at 12 px regular, tracked 0.08em. Matches the 12 px button labels so all caps text shares one size, and the lighter weight keeps it under the title. s04 asks for 13 px minimum while listing 11 px labels in its own scale; 13 px is a one-value change if brand wants it.
  • Buttons keep the shop's mixins. btn-base is 12 px at 0.14em, outside s04. Changing it is a shop-wide decision, so the layer uses it as is and the text action matches it.
  • White ground, Archivo text. s03 names Ivory as the page colour and s04 names Helvetica Now; the shop's V2 tokens use white and Archivo, and the layer follows the shop.
  • No shadows, no backdrop. A hairline and the white surface separate the layer from the page, and nothing darkens the art.
  • Wording verbatim. Including the full stop in “Ja, ich möchte wechseln.” and “Shop” in the eyebrow (Brandbook prefers “Galerie”). Both are content, left for the copy owners.
  • French text is a placeholder. The fr.lumas.com layer will show the glossary's French strings for the LM-14080 keys; the arrival line reuses country.france.
